Summary: Your internet dropped because the Wi-Fi signal weakened and the router stopped responding, likely due to distance, interference, or a temporary issue with the router.
likely_cause: A weak Wi-Fi signal and router unresponsiveness caused the connection to drop.
Evidence: The Wi-Fi signal dropped from 4/5 to 1/5 just before the drop at 3:21:51 AM.
Router stopped answering the network requests at 3:20:51 AM and failed to respond in three out of six checks.
Event details confirm the drop was due to signal loss, not a driver or update issue.
No recent changes, installs, or updates were recorded in the past 7 days.
Steps: Moved closer to the router to improve the Wi-Fi signal.
Restarted the router to refresh the connection.
Checked if other devices on the same network also lost connection.
Tested the internet with a mobile hotspot to confirm if the issue is with your router or Wi-Fi.
